name: Ada Pennowick-Reyes
summary: Third generation at the agency. Reviews every new homeowners and umbrella account herself.
body: Ada grew up in the Main Street office and took over from her father in 2014 (story). She handles complex personal accounts: older homes, collections, households with several properties.

name: Tomas Brightling
summary: Works with contractors, shops and restaurants. Knows workers' comp class codes by heart.
body: Tomas spent eight years as a carrier underwriter (story) before joining. He meets every commercial client at their location before the first renewal.

name: Priya Halvorsen
summary: Home, auto and flood for families across the river wards. Runs the annual coverage reviews.
body: Priya runs the flood map check for every client within a mile of the river and keeps the agency's rebuild-cost worksheets current.

name: Desmond Achebe-Lowe
summary: Term life and disability income, sized with a one-page worksheet instead of a sales pitch.
body: Desmond also helps business partners set up life insurance for buy-sell agreements.

name: Marisol Vantongeren
summary: Policy changes, ID cards, certificates and billing questions. Usually the first person who answers the phone.
body: Marisol handles the day-to-day: adding a car, changing a mortgagee, issuing a certificate of insurance the same day.

name: Kit Oduya
summary: Stays with you through a claim: first call, adjuster visit, settlement and anything that stalls.
body: The carrier pays claims; Kit makes sure the claim is filed with the right facts and that nothing sits unanswered for more than two business days.
